historical_direct_protocol_scope: The original published v92 execution protocol is only a Git proof of the profile and stays outside the capsule. Its historical local machine binding is not an input to the Direct adapter.
transport_scope: Existing private preflight remains local. All new Direct and overlapping Direct pins were rehashed and release-scanned; inherited ARM-only assets were checked for existence and size. No archive, receipt for dispatch, render, inference or reservation was created.
